The '''Mk 2/S heavy blaster cannon''' was a type of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]].<ref name="MBC">''[[Star Wars Miniatures Battles Companion]]''</ref> The [[Kelliak Arms and Armor Company]] [[Freerunner/Legends|Freerunner]] was armed with two of these weapons.<ref name="SBP">{{JournalCite|9|Stand at Bhir'khi Pass (article)}}</ref>
